  An empty list or an empty search: a round icon, a title, a hint and an optional action, in a card or plain.

-->
<script lang="ts">
export type EmptyPanelProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  icon?: string;
  cta?: string;
  ctaHref?: string;
  layout?: "card" | "plain";
  actions?: "button" | "none";
  visual?: "icon" | "image";
  size?: "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Container from "../primitives/container/container.vue";
import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.vue";
import Text from "../primitives/text/text.vue";
import Title from "../primitives/title/title.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  icon = "inbox",
  cta,
  ctaHref,
  layout = "card",
  actions = "button",
  visual = "icon",
  size = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<EmptyPanelProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block tag="section" :aria-label="(landmarkLabel ?? title)" data-testid="empty">
    <Container
      :class="cn('mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4', (((size as string) === 'compact') ? 'py-4' : 'py-8'))"
      data-slot="container"
    >
      <Stack
        v-if="((visual as string) === 'image')"
        gap="4"
        align="center"
        class="mx-auto max-w-md text-center"
        data-testid="empty-visual"
      >
        <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="4/3" class="w-full max-w-xs" />
        <Title :as="2" size="2xl" weight="bold">
          {{ title }}
        </Title>
        <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {{ text }}
        </Text>
        <Button
          v-if="((actions as string) === 'button')"
          variant="default"
          size="sm"
          :href="ctaHref"
          data-testid="empty-action"
        >
          {{ cta }}
        </Button>
      </Stack>
      <EmptyState v-else
        :icon="icon"
        :title="title"
        :text="text"
        :class="cn(
          'mx-auto max-w-xl',
          (((layout as string) === 'plain') ? 'bg-transparent inset-ring-0' : ''),
          (((size as string) === 'compact') ? 'py-6' : '')
        )"
      >
        <template #action>
          <Button
            v-if="((actions as string) === 'button')"
            variant="default"
            size="sm"
            :href="ctaHref"
            data-testid="empty-action"
          >
            {{ cta }}
          </Button>
        </template>
      </EmptyState>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
